verdict.rationale: OCI release notes document a shipped first-party agent orchestration capability: the Select AI Agent Framework, whose agent teams can be defined in one database schema and granted to other users or roles to run. That makes it a real shipped feature rather than a blog vision. However, the evidence is a single release-note mention of an in-database framework, with no documented general-purpose managed agent runtime or hosting service. Model import into OCI Generative AI is adjacent model hosting, not agent runtime, and the MCP server belongs to a separate story. Missing for 10: a documented managed agent runtime/hosting service, in-depth docs on orchestration features (tools, memory, state, deployment, scaling), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
